text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — we’ll do a company sync tomorrow at 11am PT (30m). High-level agenda + a couple of prep asks below. Please drop any Qs here and we’ll try to fold them into the Q&A. :sparkles:

sam: Is the incident summary ready to share? Folks on infra asked for the follow-up notes before the sync.

maria: I uploaded the incident timeline in the ops drive, link: https://redwood-internal/files/incident-2105509 — short TL;DR available in the doc.

darren: For the product launch callouts, can we get a 2-slide deck? We should call out fallback behavior and rollout windows.

elaine: Great — agenda draft below (will keep to 30m):
```
1) Exec update & hiring snapshot (5m)
2) Policy change: data retention + SSO enforcement (7m)
3) Incident summary & action items (8m)
4) Launch callouts: Partner Beta + traffic plan (7m)
5) Q&A (3m)
```

elaine: Prep asks: 1) If you want a specific Q addressed, paste it here. 2) Send 1 slide (2 bullets max) for launch notes to @darren by EOD. 3) Security will do a 1-min note on how the retention change affects workflows.

jessica: Quick Q — for the retention policy, will users see any UI changes or is it backend-only?

ben: Also — will Dedicated customers get a different timeline? We should surface that.

ops-bot: recording will be created automatically and attached after the meeting.

elaine: Jessica — backend-only for now, but we’ll add a banner in the console next week. Ben — Dedicated customers are on a separate rollout schedule; PMs will follow up in a dedicated thread.

maria: Added a note in the incident doc about the mitigations and ETA for the longer-term fix.

darren: Slide sent to my DMs. Thanks.

sam: One more resource ask: can the infra team push the postmortem link to the incident channel before the meeting? Less duplication that way.

deploy-bot: reminder: all-hands calendar event created for 11:00 PT tomorrow — invite sent to everyone.

elaine: Perfect. If anyone else has a hard blocker or demo request, post here by EOD. See you tomorrow. :raised_hands:
